scenes.text: Estimate 128 plus 36 by rounding each number to the nearest ten. Let us think carefully. 128 rounds to 130 and 36 to 40. The answer is 170. Great work!
Estimate 158 plus 56 by rounding each number to the nearest ten. Let us think carefully. 158 rounds to 160 and 56 to 60. The answer is 220. Great work!
